description: This file defines enums, structs, and functions related to probing and handling remote gateway connections, including authentication issues, connection validation, and SSH checks.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeSuccess
classes.description: Represents a successful connection to a remote gateway, including the authentication source and descriptive titles.

methods.name: RemoteGatewayProbe.run
methods.description: Asynchronously probes the remote gateway, validating URL or SSH target, and returns the connection status.

methods.name: isValidWsUrl
methods.description: Checks if the provided URL is a valid WebSocket URL for the gateway.

methods.name: sshCheckCommand
methods.description: Constructs an SSH command to verify SSH target validity.

methods.name: formatSSHFailure
methods.description: Formats error messages from SSH command failures, especially host key verification issues.
